name: Columbia University
character: The 32-acre urban campus in Morningside Heights was designed along Beaux-Arts planning principles with a lower part and an upper terrace.

landmarks.name: Low Memorial Library
landmarks.quote: Low Memorial Library, a National Historic Landmark and the centerpiece of the campus
landmarks.look: Grand Beaux-Arts centerpiece library with long granite front steps.

landmarks.name: Butler Library
landmarks.quote: Butler Library is the largest in the Columbia University Libraries system
landmarks.look: One of the largest buildings on campus, plain library.

landmarks.name: South Field
landmarks.quote: leading from the lower part of campus (South Field) to its upper terrace.
landmarks.look: Open lower campus field below the granite steps.

landmarks.name: Philosophy Hall
landmarks.quote: Philosophy Hall is listed as the site of the invention of FM radio.
landmarks.look: Historic academic hall on the Morningside Heights campus.

landmarks.name: Pupin Hall
landmarks.quote: Also listed is Pupin Hall, another National Historic Landmark
landmarks.look: Historic academic hall housing physics and astronomy departments.

landmarks.name: Earl Hall
landmarks.quote: Other buildings listed include Casa Italiana, the Delta Psi, Alpha Chapter building of St. Anthony Hall, Earl Hall
